__about.body__:
{app}

Version {version}

Created and developed by Nicolás Alfaro.

Accessible Windows application to download and play music and videos from the Internet, designed to be used entirely with the keyboard and with screen readers.

Compatible with NVDA and JAWS: the program speaks directly to both screen readers, without relying on additional Windows voices.

To see what's new in this version, go to Ayuda > Novedades de esta versión.
To see all of the program's features, go to Ayuda > Manual de usuario.

__help.shortcuts__:
GENERAL COMMANDS

Alt+1: go to the URL tab.
Alt+2: go to Search YouTube.
Alt+3: go to Channels and playlists.
Alt+D: download the focused item when applicable.
Alt+R: play the focused video.
Alt+I: information about the focused item.
Alt+C: copy the focused item's URL.
Alt+F: add or remove the focused video or playlist from Favorites when applicable.
Alt+Q: add to the queue. In a video list, if items are selected, all selected items are added; otherwise the focused item is added. On a playlist, add the entire playlist after confirmation.
Alt+L: clear the search field.
Ctrl+Shift+D: download selected videos in Channels and playlists.
Ctrl+Shift+Q: add selected videos to the download queue.
Ctrl+L: go to the URL field.
Ctrl+B: go to search.
Ctrl+O: choose folder.
Ctrl+I: URL information.
Ctrl+H: view history.
Ctrl+K or Escape: cancel download.
Ctrl+Q: exit.

IN CHANNELS, LISTS AND PLAYLISTS

Space: select or clear a video.
Enter: open actions for the focused channel, playlist or video.
For a playlist, Enter lets you view contents, add the entire playlist to the queue, select a range, use Favorites, view information or copy its URL.
Alt+R: play the focused video.
Alt+D: download the focused video.
Alt+I: information about the focused item.
Alt+C: copy the focused item's URL.
Alt+F: add or remove the focused video or playlist from Favorites.
Alt+Q: add selected videos to the queue; if none are selected, add the focused video. On a playlist, add the entire playlist after confirmation.
Alt+L: clear the channel or playlist search.
Ctrl+Shift+Q: add selected videos to the queue.

INTERNAL PLAYER

1: rewind.
2: pause or resume.
3: fast forward.
4: stop.
5: decrease speed.
6: increase speed.
7: lower volume.
8: raise volume.
E: turn the experimental equalizer on or off (remembered for next time).
9: announce current position.
0: announce total duration.

__whatsnew.1_8_1__body__:
- Favorites (Alt+F) and Download queue (Alt+Q) to organize what you want to keep or download.
- Optional backup using a cookies.txt file or browser session for videos that request verification.
- Search results no longer show technical links: just title, channel, date, views, and duration.
- New user manual in PDF and text, available in the program's six languages.
- Accessibility improvements when starting and closing the program, tailored for NVDA.
- You can choose the download engine's update channel: Stable, Nightly, or Development.

__whatsnew.1_8_3__body__:
- New experimental equalizer in the internal player: reproduces the equalization curve the developer configured in Stereo Tool. Toggle it with the E key; it is off by default and the program remembers your preference for next time. Being experimental, it may still be adjusted in future versions.
- The internal player's volume control is now more precise: each press of 7 or 8 changes the volume by 2% instead of 10%.
- The program can now also be used as a quick player from Windows Explorer: from Tools you can add "Play with Descargador de Música Accesible" to Windows' Open With menu. Once added, pressing the Applications key or right-clicking a song (MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG or WMA) and choosing that option plays it immediately, without showing the main window or the spoken welcome message. That same Tools menu item lets you remove the option when you no longer need it.
- Help, What's new in this version was added, so you can check this list of changes again whenever you like, without waiting for the next update.
- The program's title bar now always shows "Developed by Nicolás Alfaro" next to the name and version.
- Fixed an issue where updating the program sometimes left the previous version installed instead of the new one; the automatic update is now more reliable and also applies faster.
